correctness.rationale: Existential forcing is a join of witness values. Double negation sends this join to the Boolean join of the regularized witness values; finiteness makes that Boolean algebra atomic. One witness per target atom proves the finite-witness condition, and the same atomic criterion gives the exact set-cover optimum. The Boolean powerset reduction is exactly Set Cover.
